title: Music Maker Hop
hook: One motion does not fit every sound.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: polished 3D music-room storybook, one clear instrument or symbol per target; visual identity: Music Maker Hop

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child matching player gestures to mechanisms
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: mechanism -> correct player action -> safety boundary
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: recall target -> abstract gesture, no shared mouthpieces
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Music Maker Hop about player actions and control: squeeze bellows, bow, pluck, strike, shake, blow, press keys, or hum; every action is attached only to instruments where it is true.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: The child reads the interface between body and instrument, but mouth instruments remain personal and loud actions stay imaginary.
